rules.sentence: If hallucinations or delusions occur only during major depressive or manic episodes, the diagnosis is a depressive or bipolar disorder with psychotic features, depending on the timing and severity of mood disturbances.
This diagnosis requires concurrent depressive or manic episodes with active-phase schizophrenia symptoms, with mood symptoms prevalent for most of the active phase.
